mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals labor market tightness that sustains consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS decline combined with CPIAUCSL 12m change < 3.0% indicates easing policy amid moderate inflation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In instances where FEDFUNDS declined and CPIAUCSL 12m change < 3.0%, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 indicate robust consumer demand for housing, supporting economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST exceeds 1200, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals expanding economic output that increases corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO has increased over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 252.0 signals accelerating inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 252.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS 12m change > 1.5%) and rising retail sales (RSAFS 12m change > 0.5%) jointly indicate robust economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In instances where PAYEMS 12m change > 1.5% and RSAFS 12m change > 0.5%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth rate (GDPC1 QoQ > 2.5% annualized) in late-cycle expansion signals continued economic strength, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 QoQ growth rate > 2.5% annualized), SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
